purpose: Validate a research-only input/output boundary observer around the unchanged frozen core/UCI. It produces custom JFR request events for actual game-runner diagnosis; no production change or strength claim.
actors: Exact frozen native build74 baseline and build76 BOUNDARY2, verified actual identities and full runtime directory membership. Only instrumented conditions prepend diagnostic classes and replace the launcher entry with a delegating wrapper; engine JARs stay unchanged.
cases: Reuse diagnostic-v1's14 history-bearing roots:14 fixed100000-node controls, then14 roots x remaining[9799,2933,500,150,51,50]ms with increment100/default30 per process. New game before each request; complete legal/PV/accounting/lifecycle and shutdown checks.
instrumentation: On: default JFR, unified GC/safepoints and Boundary2TimingMain. Capture input go, position, delivered bestmove, original UCI elapsed/nodes/termination, actual owner-thread and process CPU. Instrumentation cannot alter allocation or Search; output bytes forwarded unchanged. Bestmove event committed after flushing real output. Off: original launch without JFR/wrapper. Request event processing cost still affects inter-request scheduling and iteration-output cost; test rather than assume neutrality.
acceptance: Exactly112 fixed-control signatures match all actor/instrument conditions; all672 clock requests legal and drained with maximum overrun<=25ms; both descriptive paired median fixed-node elapsed ratios within.95..1.05; host<=2 other cores and memory>=8GiB/load<=75%. Each instrumented process must provide exactly98 valid custom events with contiguous ordinals, command/identity/node/elapsed/termination parity to independent client capture, nonnegative owner/process CPU and complete delivery. Approximate event/request timing must be consistent. No equivalence or worst-case guarantee is inferred from this finite calibration.
resources: Serial BelowNormal owned job,30s admission and15min watchdog, no overlapping computational experiments. Retain all failures and exclusive output names.
continuation: Only a passing bridge may instrument an outcome-blind actual Fastchess diagnosis. Existing development openings only; new strength design remains gated on timing investigation. No historical withheld results are read.
